QuorumCtl 3.4.1 - open-source replication manager

Usage: quorumctl <subcommand> [flags]

Subcommands:
  status       Show cluster membership, lease holder, and replica lag
  inspect      Show node health, WAL position, and storage checks
  fence        Revoke a node lease and stop database service on a node
  promote      Promote an eligible replica after safety checks
  verify       Run cluster and write-path checks
  reconfigure  Change the client service endpoint

Examples:
  quorumctl status --cluster orders-prod
  quorumctl inspect --node orders-db-b
  quorumctl fence --cluster orders-prod --node orders-db-a --confirm
  quorumctl promote --cluster orders-prod --node orders-db-b --confirm
  quorumctl verify --cluster orders-prod --writes
  quorumctl reconfigure --service orders-api --endpoint orders-db-b

The manager refuses promotion of a node marked delayed or promotion_ineligible. A fence is not complete until status shows the old lease as revoked.
